You are entering a fictional zone: reality has been suspended.
In 2086, after nearly seventy years of humanity living in total invisibility, the sudden reappearance of a few individuals fractures society once more—forcing one "Invisible" to navigate fear, connection, and identity in a world that no longer knows how to be seen.
"Visible" by Clay Delauney
Starring Henry Ian Cusick and Sonya Walger from the ABC hit series "LOST"
